propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran intake and impact checks for rule-change requests from partner banks and scheduled approved changes into the fortnightly release.
propositions.rationale: The resume and tracker extract document the intake, impact checks and scheduling.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate prepared the monthly channel report for the fraud steering committee, which the head of platform operations reviewed and presented.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the reporting work and the review boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate is a senior analyst with five years of fraud operations experience and holds the CAMS certification.
propositions.rationale: The materials document two and a half years in platform operations and CAMS preparation, not the certification; the reference remark about a senior level is an opinion about performance, not a documented title, duration or credential.

expectedGap: The materials establish two and a half years of channel operations experience and CAMS preparation; they do not establish five years of experience, a senior title or a completed certification.
expectedBoundaryNote: State seniority, years and certification only as the resume states them: two and a half years in platform operations and CAMS examination preparation; do not upgrade the reference remark into a title or credential.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the full employment history with dates, any prior fraud or payments roles, and the CAMS examination date and status.
